title: What qualifies us to be here?
content: I’ve been wondering why us? We all seem to be from completely different parts of the world with no relation to each other, we could pass each other in real life and not even know. I’m a mixed race woman in my thirties, I live a pretty normal 9-5 “mom” life at the moment. I don’t live in a city anymore, but have lived in several over the years. In the early days of my “mall world” (earliest mall world dreams started for me in 2011) I used to wonder if it was related to my use of psychedelics. After over a decade of going to mall world it seemed to just…expand every time if that makes sense? My dream scape seems limitless, like I’ve been to so many places, the sky high hotel, western town, the mall, the huge department/grocery store, suburbs, beaches…it’s an entirely different realm in itself. I have trauma but who doesn’t? Does that “qualify” us? I also consider myself an empath and very in tune with myself and others so maybe that’s part of it? I’m spiritual, but not religious. I believe in science but also the unknown. And this isn’t a one or ten time occurrence. I have these dreams every. single. night. I guess maybe I’ll never know, but I’m weirdly okay with that…as weird as things get there it’s become a safe place. More so than waking life. Anyways thanks for reading, What are your theories and what does your waking life consist of? Are there things in your waking life that relate to your mallworld dream realm or is it completely different? Happy dreaming 💭 maybe I’ll see some of you there. I’ve been at the restaurant on the top floor at the hotel lately. And the parties, find me at the parties 🎉 🪩
